Prime Video India and CJ ENM have signed a multi-year distribution deal. This agreement will bring more than one hundred Korean shows to Indian viewers. Twenty-six new shows from CJ ENM will be released over the next two years. Existing popular library titles will also become available for streaming. All content will feature English subtitles and Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs. Twenty-six new shows from CJ ENM will be released over the next two years Reuters Prime Video India has signed a multi-year distribution deal with South Korean entertainment studio CJ ENM to bring more than 100 Korean shows to Indian audiences over the next two years, expanding its international content slate The deal covers more than 100 titles, including 26 new shows from CJ ENM that will be rolled out over the next two years, along with a selection of the studio's existing content library Manish Menghani, director and head of content licensing at Prime Video India, said the agreement was backed by rising consumer demand for Korean dramas and reinforced the platform's commitment to offering international content Live Events Jangho Seo, executive vice-president of Platform Division at CJ ENM, said the partnership would help the Korean studio reach a wider audience in India through Prime Video's distribution network and deepen its engagement with viewers in the country.
